title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
summary: OpenAI's security team disrupted a Russian-linked covert influence campaign that was exploiting their AI models to generate and distribute political disinformation across social media platforms, marking one of the first major documented cases of state-sponsored actors using commercial AI for influence operations.
problem_solved: Addresses the weaponization of AI technology by nation-state actors for conducting sophisticated influence and disinformation campaigns at scale.
why_valuable: Demonstrates proactive platform governance by AI companies and provides transparency into how AI systems are being misused for geopolitical manipulation, setting precedent for industry-wide security responses.
